data.body:
### Changed
- Feature in one of previous releases breaks REST filter with "search" field for documents, customers and other entities ([#33883](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3383))
- Asset loading error through php artisan serve, version requirements needed and docker setup ([#3319](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3319))

### Fixed

- Fix bill payment email template ([#336](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3368))
- Fixed search string = operator returning an array instead of a string ([#3373](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3373))
- Fixed database host and port not being applied to the current connection on install ([#3378](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3378))
- Opening an already-sent invoice's Edit page and saving with zero changes silently overwrites its stored tax amount to reflect the CURRENT tax rate, not the rate that was actually charged. ([#3381](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/issues/3381))
- Remove two array keys that a later duplicate already overrides ([#3394](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3394))
- Fix: include plain-value columns in search string token validation ([#3396](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3396))
- Fix: center operator icons in search filter dropdown ([#3397](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3397))
- Fix: guard dashboard slider against single-dashboard mount ([#3398](https://github.com/akaunting/akaunting/pull/3398))
